title: Agent state per pane from Claude Code hooks, answered from the manager list
notes: A hook script posts permission_prompt, idle_prompt, agent_needs_input and agent_completed to the app. Main keeps a state per pane, keyed by an environment variable the app sets at spawn. The manager row shows the state and the question text; a key on the row sends the answer to that pane. Bell detection stays as the fallback for shells that are not Claude Code.
